title: Journey plays kept whole, and the measured decide, data and learn decisions written where the store reads them
request: The owner: 'make sure all data must capture and record and store for all 6 models we have'; plan 2026-10-25 Part A2 and A3, before any new data is made.
spec: A2: workflow_models.play keeps each collected play whole (ledger, drafts, project, events) where the store reads a workspace. A3: the layer 5, 2 and 6 measurements' decisions as ledger records with measured labels, in each measurement's own workspace.
plan: Find where plays and measurements lose their records.
Keep the records, leave out the invented tables with their hashes.
Name the person and the table as the dataset so the store keeps each in one split.
Write each measured decision with its measured label; test both.

decisions.decision: A play is kept only when DCLAB_JOURNEY_PLAYS is set, which the CLI's collect sets and the gate never does.
decisions.why: A sealed person's play kept in agent_runs would be shaped by the store into training sets; tests must not write into agent_runs.

decisions.decision: The invented tables are left out of a kept play, each named with its size and SHA-256 in LEFT_OUT.json.
decisions.why: A play is 13 MB, almost all replica tables a seed rebuilds; 1,200 plays would take 15 GB of a disk with 12 GB free; the records are about 100 KB.

decisions.decision: A kept play's decisions carry dataset journey:<set>:<person>.
decisions.why: One person, one group in the store: the two seeds of a person never split between train and dev.

decisions.decision: The measurements' decisions go to the ledger, not only to an evidence campaign.
decisions.why: The store builds the m1 and m3 decision sets from shaped ledger records; campaign results reach m3 only as model-selection experiments.

decisions.decision: Existing points only: threshold.operating_point (the share acted on), data.more_rows, model.promote; new state fields in dclab_core 0.112.1.
decisions.why: No new point before a measurement shows a student is worth building; misusing an existing field would teach a student the wrong meaning.

decisions.decision: The operating-point measurement now records the best share in hindsight and each method's choice; the first 14 tables' lines lack them and get no label.
decisions.why: The label needs the hindsight share; results are never edited, so the early lines stay as they are.

change: dclab_rnd/workflow_models.py (PLAYS, kept_folder, _tidy, play keeps under DCLAB_JOURNEY_PLAYS, collect sets it); dclab_rnd/ability_records.py (new: threshold, more_rows and retrain writers, python -m dclab_rnd.ability_records all); dclab_core/ledger.py (STATE_FIELDS cost_ratio, calibration_error, window_rows, gain_low, gain_high, capacity_share) and the 0.112.1 CHANGELOG; tests/test_journey_plays_kept.py and tests/test_ability_records.py (new); the layer 5 measurement script records oracle_share and chosen.

findings.defect: Every journey play threw its whole record away.
findings.scenario: workflow_models.collect played 302 journeys in temporary folders: only the learned points' rows survived; the conversations, drafts and every other decision were lost to the workflow LLM (m4) and the step-by-step model (m6).
findings.cause: A TemporaryDirectory for the play's ledger and journeys.play called without keep.
findings.fix: A durable folder per set, person and seed, with the play's ledger inside its workspace and its events in workspace/experience.

findings.defect: A kept play's events would sit outside its workspace, where the store does not read them.
findings.cause: The keep folder was made for reading by people, not by the store.

findings.defect: The three measurements' decisions reached no model set.
findings.scenario: results.jsonl under agent_runs is archived raw; no shaper reads it.
findings.cause: Measurement scripts outside the product write their own files.
findings.fix: ability_records writes ledger records with measured labels in each measurement's workspace.

findings.defect: A yes/no point was written with 'yes' and 'no'.
findings.scenario: model.promote records were refused: a yes/no point answers true or false.
findings.cause: The point's answer type was not read before writing.
findings.fix: Booleans for model.promote's value, answers and labels.

findings.defect: The operating-point measurement had no record of the best share in hindsight.
findings.scenario: Its truth (the label) could not be written.
findings.cause: Only the best value was kept.
findings.fix: oracle_share and each method's choice recorded; the run restarted (14 tables before it stay as they are).
findings.test: a dry run on an invented table

measurements.name: affected tests
measurements.gate: affected tests only (the owner's daytime rule)
measurements.result: the new tests pass (2 and 1), with test_workflow_models, test_ledger, test_conformance, test_core_contracts, test_core_adapters, test_real_screen, test_datasets, the store sets and shapers
limits: the store has not yet been rebuilt with these folders: the counts per set come with the next store build

outcome: Every journey play the workflow collection makes is kept for m2, m4 and m6, and every measured decide, data and learn decision is written for m1 and m3 with its measured label.
lessons: A temporary folder in a data pipeline is a decision to lose data: say so in the code or keep it.
Read a point's answer type before writing its records.
risks: The experience events of a kept play are grouped in the store by their draft or project, not the person: a person's two seeds can split for the conversation sets (the decisions do not).
